title: Base Node Schema
description: Base schema for all node types in the IGVF Catalog. Defines common required properties.

_key.description: Unique identifier for this record within its collection. Key composition is collection-specific: a stable source accession where one exists (for example the Ensembl gene ID ENSG00000197976 for genes), otherwise a composite of the fields that make the record unique (for example chr_pos_ref_alt_assembly for a variant).

name.description: Human-readable display label for this record, such as a gene symbol, ontology term name, or drug name. Not guaranteed to be unique.

source.description: The source of this record, such as IGVF, ENCODE, GENCODE, or Cellosaurus.

source_url.description: Link to the specific upstream record or file this data was loaded from, for example https://data.igvf.org/tabular-files/IGVFFI0332UGDD/.
